summary.text: STIFTELSEN NORDLAND MUSIKKFESTUKE is a foundation registered in Bodø, founded 1988-05-01. Its website describes the business as follows: "Det ligger i navnet at Musikkfestuka skal være en musikkfest, og aller helst en musikkfest for alle." Its main industry code is 90.390: other support activities to arts and performing arts. The register shows 6 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 10 205 135 NOK and the annual result was -1 445 091 NOK; operating income was down from 12 779 956 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -1 866 666 NOK in 2024 to -1 445 091 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 6 095 765 NOK in 2024 to 4 650 674 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is musikkfestuka.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn profiles. The latest news on its own website is "Aase blir ny programsjef" from 2026-09-26. The registered employee count went from 5 on 2026-06-13 to 6 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
